patterns.note: Sections are full-bleed with distinct background colors, often featuring large, impactful headings and a mix of illustrative and photographic content.
The site uses an extremely oversized, bold sans-serif typeface for main headings, creating a strong visual hierarchy and a modern, confident tone.
A vibrant and energetic color palette dominates, primarily using a bright, almost neon green and a sunny yellow, contrasted with black text and occasional light beige sections.

A continuous, winding 3D-like path illustration acts as a primary visual element, parallaxing against fixed text elements in the hero section and revealing new content and characters as the user scrolls down the page.
Key information is presented in distinct, full-width sections with alternating background colors (green, photo, beige, yellow) to clearly delineate content blocks.

technique_notes: The site employs a sophisticated scroll-driven animation system, likely using locomotive-scroll, to create a smooth scrolling experience. A large, illustrative 3D path is rendered, possibly with canvas or Rive, and scrolls with a strong parallax effect against static viewport elements. New content sections and individual elements within them (like number cards) are revealed with staggered fade-up or slide-in animations as they enter the viewport, triggered by scroll position. The main navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, heavy-weight sans-serif headings (~4-5x body text) create a dominant visual presence, while body text remains clear and legible.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are applied consistently to buttons, cards, and section containers, contributing to a friendly and modern feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within hero areas, balanced by a more standard density in feature grids and footer content.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the dynamic, winding 3D-like path illustration that serves as a continuous visual narrative throughout the page, guiding the user's eye and revealing content with a strong parallax effect. This, combined with the bold, almost neon color palette, creates a highly engaging and memorable experience.
